fields.description: Ticked = checkout goes through the CyberSource test host (testsecureacceptance.cybersource.com), using the test profile People's Bank issued you. Untick only once the Live section below is fully configured and tested.
fields.label: Use Sandbox

fields.description: Test Profile ID from People's Bank - a UUID, e.g. 3DEEB7C4-3568-4CDF-8247-1A15527CD3B2.
fields.label: Sandbox Profile ID

fields.description: Test Access Key for that profile - 32 hex characters. Posted from the browser by design; it is not a secret on its own.
fields.label: Sandbox Access Key

fields.description: Test Secret Key for that profile - a long hex string. This is the HMAC key: it never leaves the server, and anyone holding it can sign a payment.
fields.label: Sandbox Secret Key

fields.description: Optional. Leave blank to post to CyberSource's own test endpoint. Set it only if People's Bank gave you a bank-hosted checkout page (e.g. their QR middle page at egateway.peoplesbank.lk) that takes the same signed fields. Must be https://.
fields.label: Sandbox Checkout URL

fields.description: Production Profile ID from People's Bank. A separate profile from the test one - never the same value.
fields.label: Live Profile ID

fields.description: Production Access Key for that profile.
fields.label: Live Access Key

fields.description: Production Secret Key for that profile.
fields.label: Live Secret Key

fields.description: Optional. Leave blank to post to CyberSource's own production endpoint. Must be https://.
fields.label: Live Checkout URL
